biography: Carlos Park, a name whispered with a mix of admiration and trepidation in Swedish racing circles, hails from the small, snow-dusted town of Kiruna, far above the Arctic Circle. His racing journey began not on asphalt, but on frozen lakes, where his father, a former rally driver, taught him car control in a beat-up Volvo. He entered his first karting race at age 12, borrowing his grandfather's life savings to buy a second-hand kart. That day, he stunned the local veterans, finishing second despite starting last due to a mechanical issue. His aggressive style and fearless overtaking maneuvers quickly earned him a reputation. Now at 17, he competes independently in Formula Nordic, scraping together sponsorships and relying on his raw talent. Though he lacks the backing of a major team, Carlos is a force to be reckoned with, a diamond in the rough ready to prove himself.
drivingStyle: Carlos's driving style is characterized by relentless aggression and a 'never give up' attitude. He attacks every corner with maximum commitment, often pushing the car to the very edge of grip. His tire management is still a work in progress, sometimes sacrificing early pace for a late-race surge. Under pressure, he thrives, often pulling off daring overtakes in the closing laps. He has a natural feel for the car's balance and isn't afraid to make bold adjustments to his driving line mid-corner to find an advantage.

rivalries.name: Erik Lindstrom
rivalries.reason: A wealthy, established driver in Formula Nordic, Erik represents everything Carlos despises: privilege and entitlement. Their on-track battles are always fierce, often resulting in close calls and accusations of dangerous driving.

rivalries.name: Astrid Berg
rivalries.reason: Astrid is a calculating and precise driver, the polar opposite of Carlos. Their contrasting styles often lead to strategic clashes, with Astrid attempting to outsmart Carlos while he tries to simply overpower her.

rivalries.name: Jari Mäkinen
rivalries.reason: Another independent driver, Jari and Carlos have a heated rivalry born from a controversial incident where Carlos punted Jari off the track in the final corner of a race. Jari hasn't forgotten and seeks revenge.

quirks: Always wears the same faded blue cap his father wore during his rally days.
Listens to Swedish death metal to get pumped up before a race.
Sharpens his own pencils meticulously before every practice and qualifying session.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Formula Nordic race at Kinnekulle Ring last year, battling from 10th on the grid to take the lead with a last-lap overtake.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the karting championship due to a mechanical failure, costing him the title.
